I can still connect to the computer of each of those bots and it appears to be live.

Grok tells me you may be able to recover them.

Thanks!

Where does the bug appear (feature/product)?

Grok Bot

Describe the Bug

Chat is stuck on Connecting on Windows Grok Bot 0.53.0 and the iPad app (same account). Messages fail to send; Retry does nothing.

Computer view still works. I can use the remote desktop and terminal on grok-bot-vm-307022897 (us11.cursorvm.com). ls still shows files written at 17:46 CST on 2026-09-16.

Desktop client heartbeat: signedIn true, crashSeen false. Local TLS to api2.cursor.sh and us11.cursorvm.com succeeds.

Started about 17:56 CST 2026-09-16 mid-session (pennbot). Already tried full quit, relaunch, sign-out/in, Windows reboot.

Please repair the chat/session channel on the backend. Do not Reset the Agent Computer. The VM and files are healthy.

Weekly usage is 24 percent (not exhausted). On-demand 0 of 20 USD.

Steps to Reproduce

Open Grok Bot 0.53.0 on Windows, signed in.

Chat with an existing bot (pennbot) until the reply stops (here: ~17:56 CST 2026-09-16).

Send a short message (e.g. “hello”). It shows Send failed; Retry does nothing.

Fully quit (tray → Quit), reopen. UI stays on Connecting and chat never loads.

Open the same account on iPad. Same: no chat response.

Open Computer view: remote desktop and terminal work (box@grok-bot-vm-307022897:/workspaces). Files from 17:46 are still there.

This is account-side. Reboot / reinstall / Reset on the client does not recover chat.

Expected Behavior

After the Computer is reachable, chat should leave “Connecting”, load existing bots, and accept new messages. iPad should work on the same account.

Computer view working should mean chat works too. Failed sends should retry or show a real error, not hang.

No Reset should be required when the VM is already healthy.

Windows 10/11

posts.name: 鑫 王
posts.cooked:
Same silent-bot issue here (Cursor Ultra / Grok Bot).

Two assistants froze in one day: one left usage_limit / resource_exhausted in automation logs (“included Grok Bot usage limit has been reached”); another hung after a long browser session waiting on WeChat QR / hand-back and never replied again. Poking did nothing — had to recreate the agent and migrate memory.

Desktop still gives almost no clear “weekly usage exhausted” banner, so it looks like a dead chat/computer and people reach for Reset. Please surface the limit loudly before bots go mute, and don’t accept messages that will never run.

Field note: 天智（TianMind） on X: "Cursor 里 Grok Bot 突然不说话，像死机？ 我们实测至少两类： ① 撞上 included usage／周额度后助手不跑，桌面端几乎不提示 ② 长浏览器会话／等人扫码交还后像挂死 Cursor 论坛已有多人报，官方也确认：额度用尽后消息照收、助手不跑，缺醒目警告。别急着 Reset 电脑。 先自救：Settings → Usage；可开 On-Demand；少开高频空转的 routine。 https://t.co/Hu27hwYVU8" / X
